inputs.original_archives: The two precise original input paths, whole-byte SHA/size and selected field body identities frozen in projection CONTRACT.json. No other scientific input is permitted.
inputs.metadata: Current exact frozen source/contract, root-specified actual RECEIPT.json SHA, receipt-bound SUMMARY.json and five archive identities; no scientific arrays read at preparation.
inputs.archive_read_rule: Each of2original and5saved NPZ archives read/hash once into memory, decode only required fields; originals may contain unused fields but they are not decoded.

full_scope: Verify original whole-file identity and consumed field shapes/dtypes/body bytes; verify four histories/order, target20..23 selection and fixed K.
Verify saved input copy is exactly the original consumed values, including bytes; never use that copy as the independent reference.
Recompute all16pairs and3145728source rows from original depth/K/P, same declared FP64 arithmetic ordering, independently coded status masks and footprint construction.
Verify all XYZ/UV/status/dense four slots/weights and all31target archive fields.

Candidate source-row/pixel/slot identities must be a complete unique permutation of all independently eligible footprints. Verify every adjacent target/Z/priority/pixel/slot tuple in strict increasing order; do not call author lexsort or any author function.
Derive rank, winner/second including equal-Z, source footprint winner, count/mask/hole semantics and exact original winner RGB independently.
Exact equality of all16pair and4target summary fields, fixed denominators and summary status; no statistical inference.

comparisons.floating_rule: abs(actual-reference)<=1e-10+1e-12*abs(reference), with full max absolute differences saved per field. Applies only to XYZ/UV/positive weights/candidate and winner depths, not eligibility, sorting or class decisions.
comparisons.rationale: Small FP64 representation tolerance for independent arithmetic re-expression; same multiplication/addition order is preserved to avoid artificial boundary differences. This is not a geometry quality threshold.
comparisons.no_boundary_repair: No epsilon, rounding/snap, tolerance-based filtering, reranking, or retry after mismatch.

resources.output: One compact review JSON only; no copied arrays or new scientific images.
resources.limits_are: SIGALRM plus per-target self peak RSS checks, not OS hard memory isolation.

interpretation: PASS means original-input numerical/storage consistency for one fixed projection batch in one exposed scene. Coverage and collision counts are not accuracy, physical visibility, independent scenes, generation improvement or innovation.
